Volume IV focuses on how humans solve high-dimensional movement in real time.
This page publishes the current chapter map and source links in `articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_IV/`.

[View Main Source Manuscript](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_IV/main.tex){.resource-link}

## Scientific Status

This volume is an active computational neuroscience and motor-control manuscript.
Claims are presented for iterative testing and traceable refinement rather than as settled doctrine.

## Source Traceability

- Primary manuscript source: `articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_IV/main.tex`
- Chapter source files: `articles/The_Geometry_of_Motion/Volume_IV/chapters/*.tex`
- Notebook bridge manifest: `notebooks/geometry_of_motion/manifest.json`

## Notebook Workflow

Each chapter has a companion Jupyter notebook in [`notebooks/geometry_of_motion/`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/tree/main/notebooks/geometry_of_motion/).
Open any notebook directly in Google Colab (no local install required) or view it on GitHub.
